title: two tickets
hook: you won two tickets to the tour. there are three of you.
openingLines: you've refreshed the email four times.
the group chat is called "us three".
setting: Chicago, the week before the tour stop, the spring of sophomore year.

self.description: Fifteen, the one who entered every giveaway for the three of you.

cast.name: Lily
cast.description: Has loved this artist since 2019, has already made a sign.
cast.want: To be the one you pick, without asking.

cast.name: Ari
cast.description: Newer to the group, funnier, could buy a resale ticket but won't say.

opening.title: The giveaway
opening.description: For a year you entered every giveaway "for us three".

opening.title: The email
opening.description: On Monday: two tickets, non-transferable, your name.

opening.title: The chat
opening.description: Lily sends a photo of the sign she made: three names on it.

background: Ari could afford a third ticket but is embarrassed to say so.
Lily has never been to a concert.
